run_zimage_pipeline: run the ZImagePipeline to generate images from text prompts with configurable guidance scale and inference steps
encode_prompt: encode text prompts into token embeddings using the tokenizer and text encoder with optional negative prompts
prepare_latents: prepare initial latent tensors with correct dimensions aligned to the VAE scale factor
calculate_shift: calculate the shift parameter for the FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler based on image sequence length
retrieve_timesteps: retrieve scheduler timesteps from num_inference_steps, custom timesteps, or custom sigmas
